svg.title: Madagascar interlock network
svg.text: 43 firms in 13 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 171 firms, 468 interlocks, 14 components (largest 128). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 58 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
